notes.title: 🌴 Introducing, Ourlands 🌴
notes.content:
Hey there! Graham here, and I'm thrilled have you along for this exciting journey. If this it the first time you're seeing this, I'm extremely proud to introduce you to my latest game! It's called [i]Ourlands[/i], and it is a cozy little game where you craft bespoke little lands for friendly little Islanders. 

In case you missed it - the official announce trailer was just revealed as a part of the Six One Indie Showcase. Check it out 👇🏽

[previewyoutube=H5EmFXgvE_Q;full][/previewyoutube]

I hope you're liking what you've seen so far (and hearing too - shout out to Fat Bard for lending their musical talents to the trailer)! There's plenty more to come, so stay tuned. Make sure you wishlist the game (below) and follow my developer page so that you get all the updates when I post them here - there [i]will[/i] be updates coming in hot right here on Steam.

I'm really looking forward to sharing more and more with you, and even moreso looking forward to seeing what you end up sharing as you eventually get your hands on the game.

Likkle more,
Graham
🌴


[h2]Wishlist Ourlands Here:[/h2]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2074470/Ourlands/

notes.title: One Year Anniversary Extravaganza
notes.content:
Hello player! Graham here. In August 2023, Roscoe, Sahsa, Ollie, Gertie, and Xander were all introduced to the world as Super Space Club made it's grand Steam debut. Fast-forward to today and it's been an awesome year with the club! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/0fd1144a07901a97ed3ab97578a2dd3ba110dfd5.png[/img]
Thanks to all those who have played over the past year, and thanks so all those who are about to embark upon their journey. This week, I'm making Super Space Club a clean 50% off! If you've already played and you're reading this, buy it for a friend (or recommend it to em so they can get it for themselves if you can't afford to). 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/08dd57d6252da6658f7588ac5ba11bccddad817f.png[/img]
If you're new to the club - welcome! I hope you join us and dive right in. There's hours of fun to be had, if not years! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/44799f45da131bf29cff203f1364a647aeb1fa3a.png[/img]

Enjoy, and thanks again for being a part of this journey!
Graham

notes.title: v1.0.3 Patch Notes - Balancing & Bug Fixes
notes.content:
We’ve made it! This is the first big balancing patch! No matter how much playtesting you do, there’s always balancing to be done, and now, we know :). Thanks to everyone who has pointed out bugs and major imbalances in the gameplay 🙏🏽

[h3]General:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Updated how ships handle turning to (hopefully) improve performance.
[/list]
[h3]Character Ability Updates:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Increased Sasha’s Blink cooldown
[*] Increased Gertie’s Charge cooldown
[*] Slightly increased Xander’s Shield cooldown
[*] Slightly increased Roscoe’s Focus cooldown
[*] Slightly decreased Olly’s Octomines cooldown
[/list]
[h3]Weapons:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly decreased Seeker damage
[/list]
[h3]Enemies:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Slightly increased turn speed for the Biggie’s laser
[*] Slightly increased the laser damage
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed objective “Don’t shoot for [x] seconds” so that it doesn’t activate until the round has started.
[*] Minor fixes
[/list]

P.S. My apologies for the download size, I have no idea what happened there. It takes up the same amount of space on your hard drive...🤷🏽‍♂️

notes.title: Available NOW! Super Space Club blasts off on Steam TODAY!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/f0cf1bb02643ac0da08527da148bb2752bea4c07.png[/img]

The long-awaited day has finally arrived! Super Space Club is now available on Steam for just $14.99. It's been a journey getting here, and I want to thank each and every one of you for following along and supporting me along the way.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/a8df0ac51aebc7bc68fe2cd62728f8bb84686bd4.png[/img]
I hope you have as much fun playing the game as I had creating it. Don't forget to take plenty of screenshots (F12, in case you weren't aware) and share them with the community. And if you love the game as much as I’ve loved making it, please leave a review and let others know what you think about it. Your review will help the game gain visibility and success on several levels.

Thank you again for your support, and I hope you blast off into a galaxy of fun with Super Space Club!

notes.title: Super Space Club is Feature Complete!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/2cdee5de6076ee06457a3a8b8d2a13ea5cc67e32.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/f0079b10ad4a52661258fa7ed6b4cb9e4e3b5a3e.png[/img]
The day has arrived, fellow space enthusiasts! Super Space Club is now feature complete. This means that all ships, characters, and weapons are in the game! I have 5 of each to choose from, so you can mix and match to your heart's content.

I couldn't be more excited to share this news with you. I've been working hard to make sure that Super Space Club lives up to all of your expectations, and I think you're going to love it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/d221314eaf991c94873055dd91e2bbcf0c045d5f.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/3fe762662461320251582f7fda36fda6f899379b.png[/img]
While I'm ecstatic to have reached this milestone, there's still work to be done. I want to make sure that Super Space Club is the best game it can be, so I'm going to be spending the next few weeks polishing it up.

I'm also planning to add some Steam achievements and other Steam-specific features to the game. And of course, I need to make a new trailer to show off all the amazing features I've added.

I'm almost there, folks! Keep an eye out for the release date, which is just around the corner. I can't wait for you to play Super Space Club and let me know what you think! If you haven't already, please wishlist the game immediately, and while you're at it, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/GrahamOfLegend]follow my developer page[/url] so you keep up-to-date with everything I'm up to going forward.

notes.title: Welcome to The Club, Next Fest!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/9019c6e0be7085653b52d266d28b9219f6f95563.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/638106347263ee36835e955c50458d4ee2570e7f.gif[/img]

What’s good, Next Fest! Welcome to Super Space Club, a vibrant lo-fi arcade space shooter loosely inspired by galactic classics that you know and love! Embark into the far reaches of space and take on waves of endless enemies to the tune of an original chill-hop score by Fat Bard. The unique contrast between the music and the gameplay delivers a relaxing yet challenging arcade experience unlike any other. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/ed4f228a35e1159a3ab384020721c66aff9b413e.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/5284a6cf9c3216062636d4db772d432a7cd1235a.png[/img]
While the game won’t be releasing until a bit later in the year, I wanted to celebrate Next Fest in style. Right now, you can hop into the pilot’s seat with a brand new demo. Start crafting your perfect build between the five characters, five weapons, and three ships available in this demo. Out of the 100+ possible combinations, how you bring your club to infamy is completely up to you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/e50a3ad8a787ad149c39b259c10776e01a835b55.png[/img]



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35216095/df4359928fcd0ff3ba39a19d7da36e4fb21a80f0.png[/img]
Once you play, I’d love to hear your thoughts on the demo and which wave you reached! And don’t forget to wishlist Super Space Club so you’re in the know for launch!

So, what’re you waiting for? Outlast your enemies and vibe to the rhythm of the stars.

notes.title: E3 2019 games every game confirmed
notes.content:
They just keep coming don’t they? A lot of games were announced at E3 2019, things that we didn’t know about, as well as stuff that’s previously announced, or expansions to already released games. Now, to the casual outsider, what we’re doing might seem absolutely nuts, but we thought we’d put together an alphabetical list of all the PC games that have been confirmed to appear at this year’s E3 show. With well over a hundred of them now in the books, the next year or so looks packed.

(more…)
